title: Camping World Holdings, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-10
summary: Camping World Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 7, 2026 disclosing amended and restated employment agreements for CFO Thomas E. Kirn (base salary $650,000, target PSU payout 40,000 shares) and Chief Administrative and Legal Officer Lindsey J. Christen (base salary $700,000, target PSU payout 50,000 shares). Both agreements include severance provisions upon termination without cause or for good reason.
key_points: CFO Thomas E. Kirn's employment agreement extended to March 31, 2029 with annual base salary increased to $650,000
CFO Kirn eligible for annual target incentive bonus of 100% of base salary and PSU awards with target payout of 40,000 shares
Lindsey J. Christen, CAO/General Counsel, employment agreement extended to December 31, 2028 with annual base salary increased to $700,000
CAO Christen eligible for annual target incentive bonus of 100% of base salary and PSU awards with target payout of 50,000 shares
Severance provisions include 18 months of COBRA benefits and payment equal to base salary plus target bonus upon qualifying termination
The company is listed on NYSE under ticker symbol CWH
